push.title: L 4-5 vs Da1e FC | You: 10.0 (best of 14)
push.body:
BellyTb1, your best of 14 with a 10.0 against Da1e FC. Hall of fame material, at least in my kitchen.

DID WELL
+ 31 passes (up from your usual 20). You kept the engine turning over.
+ 2 key passes (up from your usual 0). You turned nothing into something more than once.
+ A hat trick against Da1e FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's a striker's instinct, and you can't teach that at a clinic.
+ Man of the Match, your 5th for us. You carried the moment and carried us.
+ You and PhogsToffees combined like peanut butter and banana. Underrated and delicious.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Old coach's advice: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
- 64% passing (20 of 31, down from your usual 73%). Mark my words: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too. Fix it and forget it.
- Lost 4-5. The comeback starts now.

Back-garden drill: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.

Lasso-ism of the day: If plan A doesn't work, the alphabet has 25 more letters.

Hold onto this feeling. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 4-5 vs Da1e FC | You: 9.6 (2nd best of 14)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 9.6. I'm officially out of superlatives, and I keep a lot of 'em in my pocket.

DID WELL
+ 4 shots at Da1e FC's goal. Shots are tickets to the goal lottery, and you bought a stack.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 2). You saw passes other folks didn't even know existed.
+ A goal against Da1e FC, your 3rd straight match scoring. Ball in the net, smile on my face. That's the deal.
+ Your vision plus BellyTb1's finishing equals a very happy coach.
+ 1.8 above average. Growth looks good on you.

WORK ON
- 1 of 4 shots on target. Write this down: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide. Easy as pie.
- Pass accuracy: 78%. The bar for top forwards is 88%+. Go clear it.
- Fell to Da1e FC 4-5. Fuel for next time.

Practice this: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.

Lasso-ism of the day: You miss every pass you don't make, and some you do. Make 'em anyway.

That's the stuff. Same time next match? - Coach Lasso
